config.notes.updateLinksOnRename: Update note links when files or folders are renamed or moved within VS Code. Ambiguous links are skipped. Changes follow VS Code saving and undo behavior; external renames are not tracked.
extension.description: Obsidian-style Markdown editing in VS Code with live preview, note graphs, editable tables, Markdown/HTML rendering and PDF export.
config.render.motion.enabled: Enable CSS effects and animated SVG. Enabled by default; respects reduced-motion preferences. Disabling retains static content and progress values. Changes apply immediately.
config.notes.newLocation: Folder for missing notes: current note folder, vault root, or custom folder. Explicit paths in links take precedence.
config.notes.newFolder: Custom folder for new notes, relative to the current vault root.
config.render.remoteImages: Allow HTTPS remote images. Disable to allow only vault and data images. Applies to editing, reading, previews and PDF. Reopen the note after changing.
config.pdf.browserPath: Edge / Chrome executable for PDF export. Leave empty to detect an installed browser; npm is not required.
config.styleSheets: Vault-relative CSS paths, applied in order. Use with YAML cssclasses to customize notes. Reopen the note after changing.
config.editor.blockPreview.enabled: Show a rendered preview above the non-table block being edited. Leaving the block syncs edits to the document; disk saving follows VS Code Auto Save or Ctrl+S.
config.graph.include: File globs to include in the graph. Leave empty to include all Markdown notes in the vault.
config.graph.exclude: File globs to exclude from the graph.
config.language: Interface language for Note Workbench. Auto follows VS Code; Chinese locales use Simplified Chinese and other locales use English. Reload Window after changing. Settings descriptions and command titles always follow VS Code.
